fato_historico: 1947: In California, designer Howard Hughes performs the maiden (and only) flight of the Hughes H-4 Hercules (also known as the "Spruce Goose"), the largest fixed-wing aircraft ever built until Scaled Composites rolled out their Stratolaunch in May 2017.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to dream bigger than ever before. Like a monumental wingspan ready to grace the skies for the very first time, your innovative spirit is craving flight. It is a good time to consider how your unique vision can lift you above current challenges. Perhaps today is the day your grandest plans finally find their lift.
frase_do_dia: Even the largest dreams need only one brave moment to take flight.
significado_numero: Represents the stability of the foundation upon which your dreams rest.
conselho: Trust in your design and prepare for a graceful takeoff into new opportunities.
